title: Sub-kilometre feasibility Phase 2: currents plus fixed windage sweep
scope: Prespecified sweep of 0, 1, 2 and 3 percent of reanalysis 10 m wind added to reanalysis currents, scored on the intersection of cases valid under all four coefficients.
summary: Adding windage improved on currents-only at every horizon, and 3 percent was best at all four. At 48 h, 3 percent gave a 27.24 km median on 158 cases versus 30.96 km for persistence and 35.19 km for causal velocity. At 6, 12 and 24 h it beat persistence (5.02 vs 5.26, 9.24 vs 9.69, 16.07 vs 17.18 km) but not causal velocity (3.96, 7.20, 15.80 km).
limitations: All four tracks are one July-August 2018 deployment episode near Puerto Rico; rolling cases overlap heavily, so case counts are not independent samples.
Forcing is retrospective reanalysis (daily-mean currents, hourly reanalysis wind), not an as-issued forecast.
No 500 m or sub-kilometre positional skill and no St Kitts validation is claimed; final claims require another deployment.
Provider track metadata has unresolved caveats, so no period is treated as confirmed.
The best coefficient is selected in-sample on the same cases it is scored on; see the validation record, where it only partly held up.
The sweep is a prespecified sensitivity analysis, not a fitted model.

evidence.summary: Aggregate summary and cross-coefficient comparison of the sweep results file.
